notes.ground: The barrens' ground is the life pass's grey-lilac retint, darker than Four Gates' grass, so at the default path_luma its roads were cream decals 1.92 times the ground beside them (ab_road, Forward+: path 175 over ground 91). At 0.15 they are 1.49 (140 over 94), and 1.38-1.52 on the three border crossings. The compatibility value is scaled by the same factor (0.24 to 0.13) and was not rendered. The tint is a warm ochre dust at chroma 1.2 (path saturation 0.25 to 0.44), a warm road against the cool grey ground and the lilac crystals. Verge trims were measured and dropped: verge_value_earth_forward 0.7 with verge_saturation_forward 1.3 moved the frames' luminance by only 1-4 levels, because most of the retinted ground is pale enough (above PALE_LUMA) to be spared the verge treatment; and at the Mirrorhold border, where the default ground already steps about 17 levels (the barrens darker), the trim widened the step to about 24. At the Whitehorn border the ground runs on unchanged. The road trims draw a cut across each inter-region road where its paint changes: on 2026-09-30 the Whitehorn crossing matched in value (149 against 147), while the Mirrorhold crossing (144 against 172) and the Sunmane crossing (153 against 169) stepped. Re-check with the ab_seam_* shots whenever a neighbour's path trims change.
notes.grass: Dry heather: a dusky plum root and a dusty lilac-grey tip. The default green palette grew dark olive speckle on the grey ground (tufts 0.75 of the ground's value, 7 % of the verge dark). A straw tip at value 1.5 stood 1.17 times as bright. This palette at 1.15, with its root lifted, stands at 1.01-1.07, with 1.5-4 % of the verge dark, and ab_road's hf95 is 33.5 (45.2 on the defaults).
notes.other: There is no grade section: this is a continent region. There is no sky section: the map declares its own sky. The probe found no water and no unpainted foliage near the hub.
notes.props: The amethyst crystals (amethyst_crystal, 120 surfaces) are the region's namesake. Under the shared Forward+ grade (SATURATION_FORWARD 0.69) they went from saturation 0.46 to 0.22 at ab_wild, pale lilac rubble on grey scree; kept (LookFoliage.keep_chroma, KEEP_CHROMA_FORWARD) they keep their violet, and the crystals' own emission keeps its chroma with them. The violet dusk sky is the region's declared sky, kept by LookSky.clearness (a violet zenith is not a clear day).
